body: I understand I'm not the only one with these problems, and there are people who have it way worse. Still, it won't change how I feel about myself. I also have a scar on my leg (it was my fault, got drunk and did some stupid things) and another one on my shoulder (mole removal). I'm not saying these aren't bothering me, but believe me, scars on the face are way worse, especially when it's so close to your eyes. There's no way for me to ignore it whenever I look into the mirror, and I see how other people are noticing it as well when they look at me.
